page.layout: One printed page, single text column. Heading block at top (ornament, title, subtitle), then running text in one column with an initial woodcut letter; a catchword-like line "Pri-" at the lower right. No marginal notes, no running head, no notes below the text.

main_text.l: DOCTRINAE PHYSICAE
Theoremata, epitomicè ac
methodicè congesta.
PHYSICA est rerum naturalium scientia.
Res naturalis est substantia finita, na-
turâ constans.
Natura est virtus effectiva, rebus naturalibus
à Deo in prima creatione indita, à qua
omnes actiones naturales oriuntur.
Actio naturalis est motus seu mutatio, cujus in-
termedio effectus naturalis absolvitur.
Res naturalis est principium, vel ex principiis con-
stans.
Principium est res naturalis, essentiam aliarum
componens.
Estq; Materia & Forma. Et utraq;, prima aut secunda.
Materia prima est principium, ex quo primò o-
mnium aliæ res naturales fiunt.
Materia prima, ut per se ipsa consideratur, o-
mni omninò formâ destituta percipitur. Cujus
tamen rudimentum quoddam in se habet, quod
illi loco formæ est: quam Privationem appellant.
Pri-

page.notes: The woodcut initial "P" is joined to "HYSICA" in the first paragraph; I rendered it as "PHYSICA" per the rule. The ornament and any decorative elements are not text. The "Pri-" at the foot of the page is a catchword and is printed on the page; it is kept in the final paragraph because it is a split word that continues on the next page. Some ornamental letters (the capital P, drop cap) were rendered as plain text.
